notes.title: Map Update now available!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Feeling lost in the dark mysteries of The Almost Gone? The Map Update will help shed some light on the poignant truths hidden in the beautiful dioramas.

In addition to bug fixes, we have added some quality-of-life settings and adjustments to improve your experience with the game. This includes:

 A map of each area is now available -a minimap has been added to the UI that doubles as a button to open the map
 Scale up the in-game UI text -so you can go easy on your eyes!
 Choose between swipe and button controls -play as you like!

Dive back into the mysterious sceneries of your empty home, eerily deserted streets and abandoned buildings with the Map Update of The Almost Gone

notes.title: The Almost Gone will release on June 25th!
notes.notes:
The beautiful dioramas of The Almost Gone will be yours to explore on June 25th!

[previewyoutube=M2TwGoTKR-0;full][/previewyoutube]

Piece together the story and discover the events that led to your tragic death, as you progress through the empty scenes of your life.

The Almost Gone will be available at $14.99, with a special 20% off launch price on its first week of release.

notes.title: The Almost Gone set for 2020 Release
notes.notes:
We are happy to confirm that The Almost Gone will be released this year on PC, Nintendo Switch and Mobile! We are still working on the game to provide the best user experience possible, and will soon run tests on hundreds of devices.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545120/78211756d79a45919c263c3084601cbc10eabf9e.gif

The Almost Gone is not only a fancy looking dioramas puzzle game, but it also features an emotional and mature story that we hope will make you shiver.

Feel free to ask any questions about this game in this thread or on our Discord channel: discord.gg/playdigious

Don’t hesitate to follow @hvgames and @Playdigious on Twitter for upcoming news about The Almost Gone!

Cheers!

Happy Volcano & Playdigious
